source_text: In Philippians, likely from prison around AD 60–62, Paul warned believers to beware "dogs" and "evil workers" promoting "mutilation" via circumcision, asserting that Christians constitute the true circumcision through Spirit-led worship and confidence in Christ alone, not fleshly credentials—which Paul himself renounced despite his Pharisaic background. [45]
